staging_pool_note: Path is relative to the shared kernel-staging export of the project artifact store; the mount root differs per build host.
note: amd64 DEFAULT, installer and rescue kernel under the unified 7.3 policy: the T2 7.3.0 FINAL build (v7.3 c03c1a14507d), package revision 7.3.0-2. 7.3.0-2 = 7.3.0-1 + 9506, which maps the brcmfmac msgbuf RX packet IDs DMA_BIDIRECTIONAL again (upstream f0ba5fd51ff2 made them DMA_FROM_DEVICE; the BCM4364 firmware reads them, so with VT-d translation every read faulted 'PTE Read access is not set' and the firmware crash-looped). The same change is posted upstream (linux-wireless, Acked-by Arend van Spriel) and carried by t2linux as 9005. 9011 (Apple SEP ANFE quirk) is upstream in the v7.3 base as 7209846a169f and no longer applied; 2010 (boot-GPU guard) is kept. Rolled out to six test hosts on 2026-10-21 (0 DMAR faults, 0 firmware crashes). The published debs differ from the build output only in DEBIAN/control Maintainer (REPACK-NOTE.txt in the pool).
